title: Prepare Version 14 for Google Play Store (TWA) submission

requirements.summary: Update all Play Store packaging/release guidance to reference Version 14 (not Version 13) while keeping existing URLs, paths, and filenames intact unless inaccurate.
acceptanceCriteria: No documentation pages or in-app guidance refer to Version 13 as the current release target; they refer to Version 14.

All referenced URLs remain in the `{origin}/...` form, and all referenced repository paths match real filenames/paths in the repo (e.g., `frontend/public/play-store-build-guide.html`, `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, `frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest`).

file_operations.description: Replace any remaining mentions of Version 13 with Version 14 in Play Store packaging/release guidance. Preserve `{origin}`-style URLs and keep existing referenced paths/filenames unchanged unless currently inaccurate.

Update the static Play Store build guide text to consistently reference Version 14 wherever a current release target is mentioned (removing Version 13 references). Keep all existing URLs and referenced repo paths unchanged unless inaccurate.
Update the TWA helper documentation to consistently reference Version 14 instead of Version 13 wherever it appears, without changing referenced URLs/paths/filenames unless inaccurate.
Update Digital Asset Links setup documentation to reference Version 14 wherever a current release target is mentioned, while preserving all existing URLs/paths/filenames unless inaccurate.

Update any in-app Play Store publishing guidance copy to reference Version 14 (not Version 13), ensuring displayed URLs remain origin-derived (e.g., `${window.location.origin}/...`) and existing link targets/paths remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure the in-app 'View Complete Build Guide' action opens the static guide at /play-store-build-guide.html in production and the guide renders correct origin-derived URLs at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the button opens `/play-store-build-guide.html` successfully in a production build.

On the guide page, the displayed Manifest URL is `${window.location.origin}/manifest.webmanifest`, the Digital Asset Links URL is `${window.location.origin}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, and the Privacy Policy URL is `${window.location.origin}/#privacy-policy`.

file_operations.description: Verify and, if needed, adjust the 'View Complete Build Guide' link so it always navigates to the static root path `/play-store-build-guide.html` (not hash-based routing) and continues to work in production builds.

Ensure the guide page runtime substitution uses `window.location.origin` and sets the displayed values exactly to `${window.location.origin}/manifest.webmanifest`, `${window.location.origin}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, and `${window.location.origin}/#privacy-policy`.

requirements.summary: Harden the Bubblewrap helper script workflow for Version 14 so it reliably produces signed AAB (and APK when available) and prints explicit next steps for assetlinks.json updates and redeploy.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `frontend/scripts/twa/bubblewrap-release.sh` completes without errors when Bubblewrap prerequisites are installed, and prints absolute paths to the generated `.aab` (and `.apk` if produced).

The script prints clear instructions that the user must replace `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME` and `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT` in `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, then redeploy so it is accessible at `${ORIGIN_URL}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`.

file_operations.description: Improve reliability for the Version 14 release flow: add prerequisite checks and clearer failure messages; ensure the build step produces a signed AAB suitable for Play Console and attempts APK generation for testing when supported; ensure absolute artifact paths are printed deterministically; keep and/or strengthen the explicit next-steps output instructing updates to `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` placeholders and redeploy to `${ORIGIN_URL}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`.

Align documentation with the hardened script behavior for the Version 14 submission flow, including what artifacts are expected (signed AAB, optional APK), and reiterate the required assetlinks.json placeholder replacements and redeploy requirement.
